name: Account Management Message Reference 5
definition: Information about the references of an account management instruction message.

StatusRequestType.name: Status Request Type
StatusRequestType.definition: Type of account management instruction for which the status is requested or a request to know the status of the account.

AccountApplicationIdentification.name: Account Application Identification
AccountApplicationIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of the account opening or account modification instruction at application level.

ExistingAccountIdentification.name: Existing Account Identification
ExistingAccountIdentification.definition: Account to which the account opening is related.

InvestmentAccount.name: Investment Account
InvestmentAccount.definition: Account information for which the status of an account management instruction is requested.

LinkedReferenceOrAccountApplicationIdent.definition: Either LinkedReference or AccountApplicationIdentification must be present.
